headline: Margin improves and outlook narrows as orders fall
summary_short: Vestas reported Q3 revenue of €5,677M, up 6% year over year, with an EBIT margin before special items of 8.5% versus 7.8%.
summary_long: Order intake was 3,377 MW (€4.1B), down 27% in MW. The combined Power Solutions and Service backlog was €77.9B. Adjusted free cash flow was €99M versus €508M a year ago. Full-year 2026 outlook was narrowed to revenue of €20.5-21.5B and an EBIT margin of 7.5-8.5%, with investments of about €1.0B instead of €1.2B. A €400M share buyback runs to mid-December.
confidence_notes: Figures were read from the Inderes-hosted copy of the company's Nov. 11, 2026 announcement because the company PDF exceeded the fetch size limit. EBIT prior-year € amount and net profit were not stated in the text read; y/y deltas are as stated by the company or from the prior-year margin.

drivers.explanation: The company attributes the increase to growth in Offshore and Service.
Better Power Solutions profitability and operating leverage lifted the margin, while higher operating costs at a European offshore project weighed on it.
The company cites commercial traction in EMEA and Asia-Pacific at higher average selling prices; it does not explain the 27% decline in megawatts.
The narrowed outlook is attributed to solid performance in the quarter and improved visibility.
